title: optional_path_posted_uncheck_roundtrips_test uses a REQUIRED cohort (student), contradicting its name and comment
detail: The test name and comment claim an OPTIONAL applicant's uncheck round-trip, but employment_status="student" is a REQUIRED cohort per the diff's own guarantor_required. No uncheck or round-trip occurs; it duplicates student_values_render_required_test's no-pretick check.
recommended_fix: Either rename to reflect the required-cohort no-pretick case, or switch values to an actual optional cohort (employed/retired) to genuinely exercise the optional uncheck round-trip.

title: unemployed_values_render_required_test omits fields_open and no-pretick asserts that the parallel student test has
detail: The unemployed test asserts only cohort and required, omitting the _guarantor_fields_open="on" and checked_shape-absent pins the sibling student test has. A regression breaking the unemployed fields-open or pre-tick would pass undetected.
recommended_fix: Mirror the student test's two extra assertions (_guarantor_fields_open "on" and checked_shape absent) in the unemployed test for parallel coverage.
